whatIs.title: Bridging Wandering Souls & Master Tattoo Artists
whatIs.lead: InkTrail is the dedicated global platform engineered specifically for travelers seeking authentic ink and tattoo artists looking to expand their international reach.
whatIs.description: Whether you are planning your dream destination piece months in advance or searching for an exceptional resident artist in a city you just landed in, InkTrail strips away the algorithmic noise and connects you directly with verified craftspeople.

certification.title: The InkTrail Certified Standard
certification.lead: The InkTrail Certified badge helps travelers identify artists and studios who have been personally reviewed by the InkTrail team.
certification.explanation: Becoming InkTrail Certified requires a visit from the InkTrail team to verify your studio's hygiene standards, sterilization procedures, safety practices, and professionalism. Artists who meet our standards receive the official INKTRΛIL Certified badge on their profile.

steps.title: Application & Studio Details
steps.description: The artist submits studio location, equipment documentation, and portfolio through the artist portal.

steps.title: In-Person Verification Visit
steps.description: An InkTrail team member visits the studio to verify hygiene protocols, autoclave/sterilization, and needle disposal.

steps.title: Certification Badge Awarded
steps.description: Approved artists receive the verified INKTRΛIL badge, giving international travelers peace of mind and confidence.

certification.disclaimer: Disclaimer: InkTrail does not verify licenses, certifications, or health standards unless explicitly stated. Certification indicates fulfillment of InkTrail internal review criteria and community trust indicators, but does not constitute a legal certification or medical guarantee.

items.question: What is InkTrail and who is it for?
items.answer: InkTrail connects travelers with professional tattoo artists worldwide. It allows travelers to discover artists by city, browse authentic styles, and connect with verified talent for unforgettable travel ink.

items.question: Is InkTrail free to use for travelers?
items.answer: Yes, browsing portfolios, discovering artists, exploring styles, and accessing contact details is completely free for all travelers.

items.question: How do tattoo artists join InkTrail?
items.answer: Tattoo artists can join by clicking 'Create a Profile'. You can set up your profile, upload your portfolio, list your styles and spoken languages, and start receiving inquiries from travelers.

items.question: What does the InkTrail Certified badge mean?
items.answer: InkTrail Certified is an internal trust indicator awarded after a personal review of the studio's hygiene standards, sterilization procedures, safety practices, and professionalism.

items.question: Where can I download the mobile application?
items.answer: The InkTrail iOS application is available on the Apple App Store via our Download page. The Android version for Google Play is currently in development.
